 The film, which Universal Pictures will release on Thanksgiving, follows Greg Focker as his son Henry brings home a new girlfriend, Olivia.

 Still operating as a helicopter parent to his two adult kids, Greg Focker's (Stiller) anxieties spiral out of control when his son Henry (Superman's Skyler Gisondo) brings home a formidable new girlfriend, Olivia (Grande), to celebrate the 80th birthday of Greg's still-intimidating father-in-law, Jack Byrnes (De Niro).
 Greg's concerns skyrocket when Olivia is embraced by everyone, including Jack, and Henry reveals that he plans to propose. Certain that Olivia is hiding something, Greg attempts to unmask her, leading to a calamitous weekend that sees the rivalry between the two future in-laws escalate from an airplane to the kitchen to the bike path.
 The all-star returning cast includes Actor Award nominee Teri Polo as Pam Focker, Oscar nominee Owen Wilson as Kevin Rawley and Emmy and Tony winner Blythe Danner as Dina Byrnes. New cast members include Golden Globe nominee Beanie Feldstein (Booksmart) as Greg's daughter, Samantha, and Eduardo Franco (Stranger Things) as her boyfriend, Eduardo.
 Directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker In-Law is produced by Oscar nominee Jane Rosenthal , De Niro, Stiller, Oscar winner John Lesher, Emmy winner Jay Roach and Hamburg. The screenplay is by Hamburg from a story by Hamburg and Tony winner and Emmy nominee Ilana Glazer & Austen Earl, based on characters created by Greg Glienna & Mary Ruth Clarke.
 The executive producers are Nancy Tenenbaum, Amy Herman , Lauren Hennessey , Michelle Graham and Berry Welsh. Universal Pictures and Paramount Pictures present a Tribeca/Red Hour/Delirious Media/Particular Pictures production of a John Hamburg film.
 FOCKER-IN-LAW opens November 25. For more information, visit the official website .
